The investment objective of WHYP is to deliver attractive monthly income and risk-adjusted long-term returns through the active management of a diversified portfolio of ETFs that provide exposure to predominantly large capitalization equity securities.
WHYP has closed the offering of its initial CDN$ Unhedged Units and US$ Unhedged Units. The Units of the ETF will begin trading on Thursday, September 10, 2026, on the Toronto Stock Exchange ("
"), under the ticker symbols noted above.

“The best partnerships bring together different strengths,” said Pat Sommerville, Co-CEO of Hamilton ETFs. “As Canada’s largest independent ETF provider, Hamilton brings significant scale, deep expertise in ETF innovation and one of the country’s largest and most experienced options teams, while Westcourt brings extensive experience in active asset allocation and portfolio construction. WHYP is an exciting opportunity to bring those distinct strengths together in a single portfolio.”

“We are excited to partner with Hamilton ETFs, combining their options expertise with Westcourt’s experience in portfolio construction and risk management. Together, we are bringing advisors and their clients an actively managed, diversified and tax-efficient core equity-income solution designed for today’s market environment. WHYP is designed for investors seeking attractive and consistent tax-efficient cash flow, with an emphasis on liquidity, and long-term capital growth,” said Rob Janson, Co-CEO, CIO of Westcourt.

About Hamilton Capital Partners Inc. (Hamilton ETFs)

With over $18 billion in assets under management, Hamilton ETFs is Canada’s largest independent ETF provider, offering a suite of innovative exchange traded funds (ETFs) designed to maximize income and growth from trusted sectors in Canada and across the globe.

Westcourt Capital ULC (“Westcourt” or the “Sub Adviser”) is a premier Toronto-based investment advisory firm, specializing in alternative investment strategies. Westcourt is recognized for its expertise in sourcing, due diligence, structuring, and monitoring investment strategies. Since inception, Westcourt has advised on or deployed over $7 billion in assets on behalf of ultra-high-net-worth investors, family offices, and advisory partners.
